settings.name: SERVER_NAME
settings.description: **Primary Domain:** The main domain name for this site. Required in multisite mode.

settings.name: BUNKERWEB_INSTANCES
settings.description: **BunkerWeb Instances:** List of BunkerWeb instances separated with spaces.

settings.name: MULTISITE
settings.description: **Multiple Sites:** Set to `yes` to enable hosting multiple websites with different configurations.

settings.name: SECURITY_MODE
settings.description: **Security Level:** Controls the level of security enforcement. Options: `detect` or `block`.

settings.name: BANS_TLS_DROP_REASONS
settings.description: **Bans Dropped at TLS:** Ban reasons (`crowdsec`, `bad_behavior`, `manual`, `ui`, `api`, separated by spaces) whose banned IPs are dropped at the TLS handshake instead of getting the 403 page. Skipped behind header-based real IP, and behind PROXY protocol unless `REAL_IP_HEADER` is `proxy_protocol`. Never applied to HTTP/3.

settings.name: SERVER_TYPE
settings.description: **Server Type:** Defines if the server is `http` or `stream` type.

settings.name: USE_API
settings.description: **Activate API:** Activate the API to control BunkerWeb.

settings.name: API_HTTP_PORT
settings.description: **API Port:** Listen port number for the API.

settings.name: API_HTTPS_PORT
settings.description: **API HTTPS Port:** Listen port number (TLS) for the API.

settings.name: API_LISTEN_HTTP
settings.description: **API Listen HTTP:** Enable HTTP listener for the API.

settings.name: API_LISTEN_HTTPS
settings.description: **API Listen HTTPS:** Enable HTTPS (TLS) listener for the API.

settings.name: API_LISTEN_IP
settings.description: **API Listen IP:** Listen IP address for the API.

settings.name: API_SERVER_NAME
settings.description: **API Server Name:** Server name (virtual host) for the API.

settings.name: API_WHITELIST_IP
settings.description: **API Whitelist IP:** List of IP/network allowed to contact the API.

settings.name: API_TOKEN
settings.description: **API Access Token (optional):** If set, all API requests must include `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

settings.name: HTTP_PORT
settings.description: **HTTP Port:** Port number for HTTP traffic. Leave empty to disable HTTP listening.

settings.name: HTTPS_PORT
settings.description: **HTTPS Port:** Port number for HTTPS traffic. Leave empty to disable HTTPS listening.

settings.name: USE_IPV6
settings.description: **IPv6 Support:** Enable IPv6 connectivity.

settings.name: DNS_RESOLVERS
settings.description: **DNS Resolvers:** DNS addresses of resolvers to use.

settings.name: CLIENT_BODY_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Client Body Timeout:** Timeout for reading the client request body.

settings.name: CLIENT_HEADER_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Client Header Timeout:** Timeout for reading the client request header.

settings.name: KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Keepalive Timeout:** Timeout for keep-alive client connections.

settings.name: SEND_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Send Timeout:** Timeout for transmitting a response to the client.

settings.name: LISTEN_STREAM
settings.description: **Listen Stream:** Enable listening for non-ssl (passthrough).

settings.name: LISTEN_STREAM_PORT
settings.description: **Stream Port:** Listening port for non-ssl (passthrough). Leave empty to disable non-SSL stream listening.

settings.name: LISTEN_STREAM_PORT_SSL
settings.description: **Stream SSL Port:** Listening port for ssl (passthrough). Leave empty to disable SSL stream listening.

settings.name: USE_TCP
settings.description: **TCP Listen:** Enable TCP listening (stream).

settings.name: USE_UDP
settings.description: **UDP Listen:** Enable UDP listening (stream).

settings.name: WORKER_PROCESSES
settings.description: **Worker Processes:** Number of worker processes. Set to `auto` to use available cores.

settings.name: WORKER_CONNECTIONS
settings.description: **Worker Connections:** Maximum number of connections per worker.

settings.name: WORKER_RLIMIT_NOFILE
settings.description: **File Descriptors Limit:** Maximum number of open files per worker.

settings.name: WORKER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Worker Shutdown Timeout:** Timeout for graceful shutdown of worker processes. Old workers are forcefully terminated after this delay during a reload.

settings.name: WORKERLOCK_MEMORY_SIZE
settings.description: **Workerlock Memory Size:** Size of lua_shared_dict for initialization workers (for example `8192`, `48k`, `16m`).

settings.name: DATASTORE_MEMORY_SIZE
settings.description: **Datastore Memory Size:** Size of the internal datastore (for example `8192`, `64k`, `64m`).

settings.name: DATASTORE_LRU_SIZE
settings.description: **Datastore LRU Size:** Slot count for the shared per-worker datastore LRU. Accepts a plain integer or `k`/`m` shorthand (for example `1k`, `10k`, `1m`).

settings.name: CACHESTORE_MEMORY_SIZE
settings.description: **Cachestore Memory Size:** Size of the internal cachestore (for example `8192`, `64k`, `64m`).

settings.name: CACHESTORE_IPC_MEMORY_SIZE
settings.description: **Cachestore IPC Memory Size:** Size of the internal cachestore (ipc) (for example `8192`, `16k`, `16m`).

settings.name: CACHESTORE_MISS_MEMORY_SIZE
settings.description: **Cachestore Miss Memory Size:** Size of the internal cachestore (miss) (for example `8192`, `16k`, `16m`).

settings.name: CACHESTORE_LOCKS_MEMORY_SIZE
settings.description: **Cachestore Locks Memory Size:** Size of the internal cachestore (locks) (for example `8192`, `16k`, `16m`).

settings.name: SESSIONS_REVOCATION_MEMORY_SIZE
settings.description: **Sessions Revocation Memory Size:** Size of the store holding revoked cookie session identifiers (for example `8192`, `16k`, `16m`).

settings.name: LOG_FORMAT
settings.description: **Log Format:** The format to use for access logs.

settings.name: ACCESS_LOG
settings.description: **Access Log Path:** File path, `syslog:server=host[:port][,param=value]`, or shared buffer `memory:name:size`; set to `off` to disable logging.

settings.name: ERROR_LOG
settings.description: **Error Log Path:** File path, `stderr`, `syslog:server=host[:port][,param=value]`, or `memory:size`.

settings.name: LOG_LEVEL
settings.description: **Log Level:** Verbosity level for error logs. Options: `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warn`, `error`, `crit`, `alert`, `emerg`.

settings.name: TIMERS_LOG_LEVEL
settings.description: **Timers Log Level:** Log level for timers. Options: `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warn`, `err`, `crit`, `alert`, `emerg`.

settings.name: AUTOCONF_MODE
settings.description: **Autoconf Mode:** Enable Autoconf Docker integration.

settings.name: SWARM_MODE
settings.description: **Swarm Mode:** Enable Docker Swarm integration.

settings.name: KUBERNETES_MODE
settings.description: **Kubernetes Mode:** Enable Kubernetes integration.

settings.name: USE_TEMPLATE
settings.description: **Use Template:** Config template to use that overrides the default values of specific settings; a value set on the service overrides the template.

settings.name: NGINX_PREFIX
settings.description: **Nginx Prefix:** Where nginx will search for configurations.

settings.name: SERVER_NAMES_HASH_BUCKET_SIZE
settings.description: **Server Names Hash Bucket Size:** Value for the server_names_hash_bucket_size directive.
